{{Top|leg}}
The '''ion charger''' cell was a power cell used in weapon customization that was attached to standard [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], and [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]]. These ranged weapons then had the ability to deal ion damage in addition to the standard energy damage. This type of ion power cell came in a range of energy output capability consisting of Marks I, II, II, IV, and V.

*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
